maddeler.e:
أتزعزع (form IIq)
# أَتَزَعْزَعُ (ʔatazaʕzaʕu) /ʔa.ta.zaʕ.za.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# أَتَزَعْزَعَ (ʔatazaʕzaʕa) /ʔa.ta.zaʕ.za.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# أَتَزَعْزَعْ (ʔatazaʕzaʕ) /ʔa.ta.zaʕ.zaʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
